changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.80[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Streaming and Networks no longer crawl[/COLOR]
-Movies > Streaming and TV shows > Networks were the only lists in the add-on left out of the catalogue precache. Every time a widget built from one of them came up cold it asked TMDb for the list and then for a full record of all twenty titles, one after the other. Both sections can now be precached like Popular or Top Rated: pick up to ten platforms and ten channels in settings and they are ready before you open them.
-Everything you did not pick can be kept fresh on a rota. Each platform and channel is renewed once a week - or every three, fourteen or thirty days, as you prefer - so what you find in them has moved on since the last time, without any of it being fetched while you wait. A pass only looks at what is actually due: anything still fresh is skipped without touching the network.
-Background work now runs against a clock. Thirty seconds by default, and when the time is up the pass stops where it is and the next one carries on from there, so a slow night for TMDb can no longer turn a start-up refresh into a long one. The Update Catalogue button in Tools ignores the clock and always finishes the job.
-Opening any list used to start one download per title with nothing holding them back, so twenty heavy requests left at once and fought each other for the connection. The same work is now spread over ten at a time. Nothing is dropped, it simply stops arriving all in one burst.
